offers_products.reason: Sells coffee, energy drinks and other beverages made and served at its drive-thru shops, plus some merchandise.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from drinks and food sold at shops; the drive-thru service is incidental to the products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Drive-thru coffee shops serve individual customers, with a rewards app and gift cards.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells almost entirely to individual drive-thru customers; no meaningful business or government buyers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Customers repeatedly buy daily-habit drinks, backed by the Dutch Rewards loyalty program.

cyclical_demand.reason: Discretionary coffee and energy drinks can be cut back or skipped when household budgets tighten.

big_ticket.reason: Each purchase is a low-priced drink bought frequently.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for beverages and drive-thru convenience, not for staff expertise; it is a food and beverage retailer.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual consumers at drive-thru shops.

asset_heavy.reason: Growth depends on building and operating many drive-thru shops, plus roasting and supply facilities.
